spec_architectural_decisions.decision: OutboundRepository.IsBroadcastCompleteAsync stays tenant-blind (keyed only on broadcast_id), NOT filtered by tenant_id.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: It is PRE-EXISTING worker code (PR-3a). broadcast_id is a globally-unique UUID PK (gen_random_uuid()) that already identifies exactly one tenant's broadcast, and it is called from the singleton MessageSenderService worker + its startup sweep, which have no per-row tenant context — the same sanctioned tenant-blind-worker exception as DequeueMessagesAsync / ResetSendingMessagesAsync (accepted in PR-3a). SS-D only widened its non-terminal status set with 'paused' (a correctness fix); it did not introduce the tenant-blindness. Adding tenant_id would force a signature change rippling into the startup sweep (out of SS-D scope, no tenant id available there).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ9/Q3 tenant_id-filter finding on IsBroadcastCompleteAsync is a FALSE POSITIVE — pre-existing worker method, UUID PK, sanctioned exception (DequeueMessagesAsync precedent). The NEW SS-D queries (pause/resume/cancel flips, cancel CTE + completion NOT EXISTS) ARE all tenant_id-scoped.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: ConfirmSendAsync enforces one-active-run by rejecting only a preview_ready (NEW dispatch) job while the project is running/paused (INV-OB-080), NOT every confirm while running.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: A confirm of an already-dispatched job (job.Status != preview_ready) is the IDEMPOTENT re-confirm path and MUST keep returning the run's live status; rejecting it would break idempotency. PreviewSendAsync rejects running/paused outright (no idempotency concern there).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: confirm guards on (job.Status=='preview_ready' AND project running/paused), preview guards on (project running/paused). This is the correct one-active-run enforcement, not a missing guard.

plan.summary: FEAT-PROJELER PKT-14 SS-D: add project-run pause / resume / cancel lifecycle. Migration 061 widens chk_message_status (+'paused' pre-terminal, +'cancelled' terminal), adds 'paused' to chk_bulk_job_status, an outbound_broadcasts.cancelled counter and a projects.cancelled_count rollup column. Pause flips a project's 'queued' messages -> 'paused' (the dequeue worker only claims 'queued', so they halt; in-flight 'sending'/'posting' are NOT recallable); Resume flips 'paused' -> 'queued'; Cancel terminalizes remaining 'queued'+'paused' -> 'cancelled' (counter cancelled++/queued--) and sets the run + project 'cancelled'. One active run per project is enforced: PreviewSendAsync rejects running/paused outright, and ConfirmSendAsync rejects a preview_ready (NEW) dispatch while running/paused (INV-OB-080) — idempotent re-confirm of an already-dispatched job is exempt. Status-aware controls land on the Projeler row. Ships gated/inert (P0-3) like SS-A/B/C.
plan.q_intent: NEXT — SS-D (pause/resume/cancel): 1. Migration 061: add 'paused' to chk_message_status (outbound_messages) + canonical sync. 2. Pause(project) = run-broadcast 'queued'->'paused' (dequeue drains only 'queued' -> halts; in-flight/sent NOT recallable). Resume = paused->queued. Cancel = remaining->terminal + status='cancelled'. 3. RecomputeRollupAsync already forward-compat for paused/cancelled — verify. 4. ProjectsPage pause/resume/cancel controls.
plan.interview_notes: Q decisions 2026-06-10 (all recommended options): (1) Cancel terminal = NEW 'cancelled' message status + outbound_broadcasts.cancelled counter + projects.cancelled_count (clean semantics; cancel != failed; keeps migration-056 reconciliation invariant sent+failed+ambiguous+delivered+read+queued+cancelled = total_recipients). (2) ONE active run per project: reject new preview/confirm while project status running/paused (new INV-OB-080). (3) Inline status-aware row controls (running -> Duraklat+Iptal; paused -> Devam Et+Iptal) + Iptal X-close confirm modal ('gonderilmis mesajlar geri alinamaz'). (4) Commit + gated prod deploy like SS-A/B/C (P0-3 gate stays closed -> inert). Verified RecomputeRollupAsync forward-compat: its status CASE preserves p.status when NOT IN (draft,running,completed), so an explicit 'paused'/'cancelled' survives rollup; counters are open SUMs of broadcast columns. Verified dequeue strictly filters WHERE status='queued'. Verified IsBroadcastCompleteAsync counts (queued,sending,posting) as non-terminal -> must add 'paused' so a paused broadcast is not prematurely 'completed'. CTE-snapshot rule (SweepStrandedPostingAsync precedent): a data-modifying CTE's effect is invisible to a sibling re-scan, so cancel's broadcast-completion runs as a separate command in the same tx.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Migration 061 is additive+idempotent: chk_message_status accepts 'paused' and 'cancelled', chk_bulk_job_status accepts 'paused', outbound_broadcasts.cancelled and projects.cancelled_count exist (NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, nonneg). DO $verify$ INV-SEED-061 asserts all four and raises on any miss. arch/db/outbound.sql canonical mirror updated to match.

POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/send/pause flips that project's 'queued' outbound_messages to 'paused' and sets project+run status 'paused'; the dequeue worker leaves 'paused' rows untouched (only claims 'queued'); in-flight 'sending'/'posting' continue. Resume flips 'paused'->'queued' and project+run back to 'running'/'sending'. Returns the fresh ProjectDetail.

POST .../send/cancel atomically terminalizes remaining 'queued'+'paused' -> 'cancelled' with per-broadcast cancelled++/queued-- (mirrors SweepStrandedPostingAsync), sets run+project status 'cancelled' + completed_at, and completes any now-drained broadcast. projects.cancelled_count is populated by RecomputeRollupAsync. Cancel is irreversible (already-sent messages NOT recalled).

Lifecycle state guards are typed (no silent no-op): pause requires status 'running' (else INV-OB-077), resume requires 'paused' (else INV-OB-078), cancel requires 'running'|'paused' (else INV-OB-079); a NEW run is rejected while running/paused (INV-OB-080) — preview rejects running/paused outright, confirm rejects a preview_ready (new) dispatch while running/paused (idempotent re-confirm of an already-dispatched job is exempt). project-not-found stays INV-OB-068. All claims are atomic (UPDATE ... WHERE status=<expected> RETURNING) so they are race-safe vs the worker and concurrent calls.

ProjectsPage shows status-aware row controls: running -> Duraklat + Iptal; paused -> Devam Et + Iptal; Iptal opens an X-close confirm modal warning that sent messages cannot be recalled. After each action the table refreshes. Build PASS (full solution, Shared changed). Ships gated/inert: ProjectsOptions default-OFF + CxapiSend empty -> P0-3 gate preserved; pause/resume/cancel endpoints registered + JWT-gated (401 unauth).

verification_questions.question: Data integrity: after pause (queued->paused, no broadcast counter change) does the outbound_broadcasts reconciliation invariant still hold, and does cancel (queued+paused -> cancelled, cancelled++/queued--) keep sent+failed+ambiguous+delivered+read+queued+cancelled = total_recipients without double counting?

Lifecycle/race: are pause/resume/cancel atomic vs the singleton dequeue worker and concurrent operator calls — i.e. does each use an atomic status claim (UPDATE WHERE status=<expected> RETURNING) so a row the worker just moved to 'sending' is never resurrected, in-flight 'sending'/'posting' are left to finish, and a double-pause/double-cancel is a typed no-op not a silent one?

Auth/tenant-isolation: are the pause/resume/cancel message + counter updates tenant-scoped (m.tenant_id, b.tenant_id, project ownership) so a caller cannot pause/cancel another tenant's broadcasts, and are the endpoints behind the Projects gate + JWT (401 unauth) while the BulkSend/CxapiSend gates keep prod inert?

Lifecycle/completion: does adding 'paused' to IsBroadcastCompleteAsync correctly prevent a paused broadcast from being marked 'completed' by the worker, and does cancel mark a now-drained broadcast 'completed' in a SEPARATE command (not a sibling CTE that would see the pre-cancel snapshot)?

Process/policy: is the one-active-run guard (reject preview/confirm while running/paused, INV-OB-080) consistent with idempotent re-preview/re-confirm of the SAME campaign, and does RecomputeRollupAsync preserve an explicit 'paused'/'cancelled' project status (CASE first branch) while populating cancelled_count?

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Every lifecycle op uses an atomic status-claim UPDATE ... RETURNING; on 0 rows the method runs a follow-up existence SELECT and returns a TYPED result (Found=false -> 404 INV-OB-068, or StateConflict -> 409 INV-OB-077/078/079 with the current status in the message) — never a silent no-op. The dequeue worker halting on 'paused' is the intended effect, not a failure. Counter updates use GREATEST(...,0) (no negative drift) and are atomic with the message update in one CTE (cancel) so a mid-write crash cannot leave a terminal message with a stale counter (same guarantee as MarkCxapiOutcomeAsync/SweepStrandedPostingAsync).

aha_moments.user_pain: An operator fires a big send to the wrong list and watches it go out with no stop button.
aha_moments.suggestion: A real Duraklat that halts the queue in-place by flipping only 'queued' rows to 'paused' (the worker claims only 'queued'), leaving sent ones honest.
aha_moments.aha_moment: They click Duraklat and the queued count freezes within a second — the bleeding stops without faking that already-sent messages were recalled.

aha_moments.user_pain: Pause/cancel buttons that are always visible but throw errors when the project isn't in the right state.
aha_moments.suggestion: Status-aware controls: running shows Duraklat+İptal, paused shows Devam Et+İptal, finished shows neither — the UI never offers an illegal action.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The button that's showing is always the one that will work — no guessing, no error toast.

aha_moments.user_pain: After a cancel, reports still show messages 'pending' forever and support can't tell cancelled from failed.
aha_moments.suggestion: A distinct 'cancelled' message status + cancelled_count rollup so cancelled is its own bucket, never混 into failed_count.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The project card reads 'İptal: 412' cleanly — support sees exactly what the operator stopped, separate from real failures.

aha_moments.user_pain: Cancelling mid-flight could double-send or strand counters if the worker and the cancel race.
aha_moments.suggestion: Atomic status claims + one-CTE counter math (mirroring the shipped SweepStrandedPostingAsync) so in-flight messages finish and queued ones terminalize exactly once.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Cancel during an active drain just works — no orphaned 'queued' counters, no resurrected rows.

aha_moments.user_pain: Hitting İptal by accident wipes the rest of a campaign with no warning.
aha_moments.suggestion: An X-close confirm modal that states plainly 'gönderilmiş mesajlar geri alınamaz' before terminalizing.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The one irreversible action asks once, in plain Turkish, so a misclick never nukes a send.

aha_moments.user_pain: Resuming a paused send means rebuilding the whole campaign.
aha_moments.suggestion: Resume just flips 'paused'->'queued' so the original recipients, order and dedup snapshot are reused untouched.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Devam Et picks up exactly where it stopped — no re-upload, no re-preview.
